mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as baCompanyName, c2.C_Name as baWageCName, c1.C_Name_History as baCompanyNameHistory, c2.C_Name_History as baWageCNameHistory, c1.C_Abbreviation as baCompanyAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as baWageCAbbName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Bank_Account_Change mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join Bank_Account ba1 on ba1.Ba_Id = mn.Ba_Id_N left join Bank_Account ba2 on ba2.Ba_Id = mn.Ba_Id_Wage_N left join SYS_Company c1 on ba1.Ba_C_Id = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on ba2.Ba_C_Id = c2.C_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Bac_Id where mn.Bac_Id = #{bacId}
